blurb: Lost Tavern Brewing operates a brewery and several tap rooms in Pennsylvania, including Hellertown, Bethlehem, and Allentown. Guests can enjoy freshly brewed local craft beer, games such as darts, shuffleboard, and ping pong, and a family-friendly atmosphere. The Hellertown location includes brewery tours and live music several nights a week.
